decision: LOCAL PROTOTYPE FABRICATION CHECKS PASS; AISLER CAM review required before order; assembled-system operation is unverified.
scope: Current display-E/GIGA-D copper, connectivity and manufacturing exports. Component identities, pad nets, placement and connector locations match the schematics. The retained component/datasheet review remains applicable. Routing, ground returns, geometry, power losses, timing estimates and exports are checked against the exact source hashes below.

manual_electrical_checks.circuit: Display pin assignment and mating connector
manual_electrical_checks.evidence: Smartwin pp12-14 and rear-view Detail A p26; Hirose EDC3-164006-03 Fig1/Fig4. All 50 contacts checked. Display plug is bottom mounted; numbering and mirrored assembly view agree.
FH28H bottom-contact sockets; same-contact-face Type-A cable gives J1.n to J2.(81-n). All 80 mappings checked, PCLK retains adjacent grounds. Exact cable purchase and continuity remain outstanding.

manual_electrical_checks.circuit: AXC8 direction, supplies and power-off behavior
manual_electrical_checks.evidence: SCES875C PW pin table and truth table: DIR1 high, DIR2 low for all-eight A-to-B. VCCA=GIGA, VCCB=panel. No 3.3V supply tie. Ioff/VCC isolation and input/output startup pull-downs checked.
AXC1 DBV pinout: A/VCCA/DIR on panel side; B/VCCB on GIGA side. INT has pull-ups, READY has MCU pull-down. No motor/EtherCAT pin conflict; READY is PI1/D70.

TCA9517A: A side=panel, B side=STM32; GIGA 5.1k pull-ups and display 4.7k pull-ups, 100kHz. VCCB/EN=GIGA, VCCA=panel. Either supply order supported per section 9; B-side low-level contention requirement checked against STM32 drive.

manual_electrical_checks.result: PASS for specified regulated supply; surge/EMC not qualified
manual_electrical_checks.evidence: TPS26600 PWP pinout, isolated RTN/EP, open SHDN, retry mode, fuse/TVS/clamp polarity and reverse VIN blocking checked. Worst calculated OVP threshold remains below converter 36V operating limit. USB/GIGA3.3 never feed display3.3.

manual_electrical_checks.result: PASS for stated allocation and thermal assumptions
manual_electrical_checks.evidence: TPS7A9101 DSK pinout/EP, 31.2k/10k 0.1% divider, SS_CTRL ground and 47nF NR/SS; input/output capacitance and 5V headroom checked. WSON underside must be soldered. Actual DC-bias capacitance, rise time, transients and junction temperature remain first-board measurements.

manual_electrical_checks.circuit: Dual rail supervision and hardware gates
manual_electrical_checks.result: PASS for circuit connectivity and component ratings
manual_electrical_checks.evidence: TPS3808 DBV SENSE input accepts 0..6.5V independently of VDD (absolute maximum 7V), so a live 3.3V backlight sense with logic supply off is within the input rating. CT=100k to VDD; nominal release 300ms (180..420ms). Both open-drain outputs share READY. SN74LVC08A gates four controls, with output pull-downs.

manual_electrical_checks.result: PASS for configuration; analog timing pending
manual_electrical_checks.evidence: Smartwin p18 samples falling PCLK; STM32 DS12930 Fig49 with PCPOL=1 changes data on rising edge. DEPOL=0 produces active-high external DE (AN4861/RM0399). 40.96MHz/1120/610 complies with supplied DE timing range. Backlight waits 200ms after standby plus a valid scan boundary.

manual_mechanical_export_checks: Both outside copper/mask/silk exports and both inner layers inspected independently of the KiCad renderer; continuous In1 ground and isolated RTN verified.
Hirose DF23 0.25x1.0mm pads, 0.5mm pitch, 3.9mm row centres and forbidden exposed-copper bands checked against drawing. FH28H 0.30x1.30mm lands and retention pads checked against catalogue.

GIGA official CAD contact centres, distinct SSQ -03/-04 tails, 13mm spacing, service cutouts, display connector orientation and <=0.8mm trimmed converter tails reviewed. Simplified models are not a physical fit test.

AISLER 4-layer ENIG rules checked online; 1.6mm +/-10%, 35um copper, layer order, mask processing, rings, hole spacing, edges, exposed vias and bridge document layers checked. No fiducials or rule waivers.
Release ZIP CRCs and nested checksum manifests verified; exported ODB matches the intended upload byte-for-byte. BOM/placement identities and orientations agree with source.

remaining_conditions.condition: Inspect AISLER CAM preview for these exact ODB archives: 4 layers, ENIG, 1.6mm, outline, drills, bridges and fine-pitch mask. No AISLER job has been uploaded here.
Confirm a supplier can make or supply the revision-E 80-way gold-contact Type-A FFC and the exact connectors/stacking headers. No exact cable MPN is qualified.
Provide controlled reflow/hot-air capability for the WSON exposed pad and fine-pitch connectors; preserve lead trim and insulating supports.

Backlight typical current is 1.05A, not a guaranteed maximum; equal-sharing contact ceiling is 1.2A. Static budget is 3.029V with assumed ripple allowance. 250mV specified load-step excursion can retrigger the supervisor. Actual PWM/full-brightness operation and current sharing are not certified.

Measure connector-level PCLK setup/hold and duty cycle with the actual cable and panel; TI propagation limits assume 15pF and 1ns/V input slew, and use 50% thresholds. Conditional calculated margins are not measured timing closure.
Verify mating fit, rails, isolation, ramp/recovery, temperature, touch and visible operation before accepting the assembled system.

routing: Straight trace runs with deliberate corners. Display GND uses filled copper planes and stitching vias, with no GND tracks. GIGA retains required component-to-plane escapes and the isolated eFuse RTN connections. Copper-covered and duplicate traces are omitted. Local display ground pours at C16 and U6 have direct through-via connections to the ground plane.
